email.body1:
Jake, saw Olo introduced the Olo Network and a consumer app launching this year.

A move that big usually opens more in-market enterprise accounts than the team can cover before quota catches up, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Olo off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jake, quick follow-up for Olo.

With a major new platform launching, the enterprise number climbs faster than headcount can. Most enterprise directors don't actually know how many booked meetings it takes to hit the target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Olo needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jake, last bit of proof for Olo.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Olo's enterprise reply rate likely compares to other restaurant-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jake, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling enterprise pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right before a big platform launch, I know the GTM stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I'll tailor it to Olo either way.
